observations: Multiple used car engines wrapped in clear plastic film.
The engines appear to be in a storage or workshop environment.
No brand or model name is visible on the engine casings in the photo.
The engine components are not clearly visible to confirm the specific 2ZR model.

claims.evidence: The engine is wrapped in plastic, and no Toyota or Corolla branding is visible.
The gearbox is not visible in the photo.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a 2ZR model as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front).

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model from the 2ZR.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine identification plate.

risks.risk: The engine may be used or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine with a handwritten note of the purchase date.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the model number.
Photo of the gearbox if it is included in the sale.
Video of the engine being tested or a photo of the engine with a handwritten note of the purchase date.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
